subject: MedLytics: private deployment architecture review & reschedule request
messages:
From: Alex Reynolds <alex.reynolds@medlytics.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Cho <sara.cho@medlytics.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private deployment review (VPC / on‑prem / air‑gapped) — sync request

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Our security team wants a focused architecture review that covers networking, KMS, and air‑gapped provisioning before we move to procurement. Can we schedule a 60–75 minute deep‑dive next week (US Pacific)? Primary goals: port requirements, diagram review, and a short runbook for installing the on‑prem agent.

Attaching a rough network sketch we prepared — it may help steer the conversation.

Preferred times: Tue/Wed 10:00–13:00 PT. If the Redwood security lead can join, that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Alex
Head of IT, MedLytics
(attachment: medlytics-network-sketch.pdf)
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Reynolds <alex.reynolds@medlytics.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, hiro_tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-02T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment review (VPC / on‑prem / air‑gapped) — sync request

Alex — thank you for the sketch, looks helpful. 60–75 min sounds right.

I copied our solutions engineer (Priyom) and security lead (Soojin) — they'll cover the install/runbook and KMS/networking respectively. Hiro can join for the on‑prem orchestration details.

We have the following openings (PT):
- Tue 2026‑10‑06 10:30–12:00
- Wed 2026‑10‑07 11:00–12:15
- Thu 2026‑10‑08 12:00–13:15 (backup)

If any of those work I can send a calendar invite + agenda. Also looping in the private deployment checklist we typically run through.

Best,
Laura
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Reynolds <alex.reynolds@medlytics.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Cho <sara.cho@medlytics.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment review (VPC / on‑prem / air‑gapped) — sync request

Laura — thanks. Wed 2026‑10‑07 11:00 PT works best for us. Please include time for a short Q&A with our cloud infra lead (Sara).

Also, one ask: can the Redwood team call out during the call whether HSM/KMS integration requires network access to Redwood or is fully customer‑managed? That determines our procurement flow.

— Alex

Date: 2026-10-03T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Calendar invite: MedLytics — Private Deploy Architecture Review (2026‑10‑07 11:00 PT)

Alex / Sara — calendar invite created for Wed 2026‑10‑07 11:00–12:15 PT. Agenda (high level):
1) Introductions and scope (5m)
2) Network diagram walkthrough (20m)
3) KMS/HSM and keyflow options (20m)
4) On‑prem agent & install/runbook (15m)
5) Questions / next steps (15m)

I attached our standard private deploy checklist and added the MedLytics sketch to the event. Link to checklist in case you want to preview: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SE/pages/PrivDeployChecklist

(attachments: rdwd-priv-deploy-checklist.xlsx)

If anything changes, please let me know — otherwise we’ll see you on Wed.

Laura

Subject: Re: Calendar invite: MedLytics — Private Deploy Architecture Review (2026‑10‑07 11:00 PT)

Quick update — our CIO has a leadership review that may run over. Is there any chance we could shift the meeting by 45 minutes later (start 11:45 PT / end 13:00 PT) or, if that won't work for Redwood, move to Thu 10/08 at 12:00 PT? Apologies for the late ask.

Alex

Date: 2026-10-04T11:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Calendar invite: MedLytics — Private Deploy Architecture Review (reschedule confirmed)

Thanks for the heads up, Alex. We can accommodate a 11:45–13:00 PT start on Wed 10/07 — I updated the invite and extended the end time to 1:00 pm PT to cover the extra buffer.

Note for the call: Soojin will lead the KMS/HSM discussion and call out which flows require outbound connectivity; Priyom will cover install/runbook and expected prep (a subset of prework items are in the checklist). Hiro will be available for any orchestration or air‑gap provisioning questions.

For convenience I added two quick links in the invite: MedLytics sketch (attached) and our runbook preview. If you want any additional diagrams added to the packet, send them to me before 08:00 PT on Wed.

Look forward to it.

— Laura
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
